student_learning_goal: I can plan a budget and calculate change.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can plan a budget and calculate change.
header.character_watermark: Pat and Bea in the top-right at a party. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 4 items from a list of 8. Total their prices.
parts.visual_layout: List of 8 items with prices and 4 pick lines plus a total line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone pick-and-total layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 8 items with prices: maple cookies $4, balloons $5, donuts $7, drinks $3, hat $2, plates $1, banner $4, candle $3. Below: 4 pick lines + total line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_PICK at Part 1: keywords name the items pick total task.

parts.visual_layout: Pay box ($20) and change calculation workspace.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone pay-and-change layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 'Paid $20.' Below: subtraction workspace ($20 - total). Answer slot for change.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_PAY at Part 2: keywords name the pay change calc task.

parts.student_instructions: If your total is over $20, swap an item to stay under $20.
parts.visual_layout: Swap workspace with new total line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capstone swap layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 'Over budget? Swap an item.' Below: 'Removed: ___', 'Added: ___', 'New total: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_SWAP at Part 3: keywords name the swap budget task.

parts.answer_key: Any valid swap that brings total under $20.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, plan a $30 budget party with 5 items.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric.
